get.description: 'Export' endpoint returns a zip file containing all assets ('Folder', 'Runlist', 'Flow', 'DataFile', 'SubFlow', etc.) on the basis of an itemId. The itemId is a unique Id of an element in the asset menu. If an itemId is not supplied the endpoint will export all assets in the asset menu available in the controller. The output zip file can be used as input parameter to the 'Import' end point or can be imported manually in Leapwork Studio. Be noticed that 'targetItemId' must be an itemId of Folder(containing flows) or Flow. To understand more about using this endpoint, please read the documentation.

delete.description: Used to delete an existing Leapwork user or an SSO user provisioned through Okta from the Leapwork application, using userId. The userId used as the input can be obtained from the 'Get All Users' endpoint with UserType as 'Leapwork' or 'ActiveDirectory'. Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) and LDAP users are not supported by this endpoint and cannot be deleted using it. To understand more about using this endpoint, please read the documentation.

parameters.description: User id to delete

delete.description: Used to remove an existing Leapwork or Active Directory user from multiple teams in the Leapwork application, using userId and TeamIds. The userId used as the input can be obtained from the 'Get All Users' endpoint with UserType as 'Leapwork' or 'ActiveDirectory'. The TeamIds used as the input can be obtained from the 'Get All Teams' endpoint. To understand more about using this endpoint, please read the documentation.
